# dim_advisors

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.dim_advisors` · dbt area: `marketplace`

Key table aggregating most of what we know about advisors, such as their certification, contact information, subscription details, profile, and user tags. Use this table when looking to segment by different characteristics of an advisor. Each row is a single advisor (a User in Portal, which could be a Community, Team, or In-House user). Sourced from the Portal database.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `advisor_id` | *Primary* Key. The 'User ID' in the Portal database  >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `advisor_string_id` | String version of the Advisor ID. Used for joining w/ Segment data.  >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `advisor_uuid` | UUID version of the Advisor ID.  >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `activated_date` | Advisors 'Activate' on the date of their first Booking, based on the booking created date.  >>  SOURCE - Portal |

| `growth_or_lifestyle_segment_current` | The Advisor's current Growth vs. Lifestyle designation. An advisor is Growth if they have 5+ booked clients (including canceled) in the trailing 365d AND either (a) trailing 365d CBV $1.5M+, or (b) trailing 365d CBV is $100K-$1.5M and 50%+ year-over-year growth, or (c) trailing 365d CBV is $100K-$1.5M and has no prior-year comparison. All other advisors at or above $100K are Lifestyle; Advisors below $100K are labeled as such. Overridden by a manual tag from the advisor_segment_tags Google Sheet when one applies on this date.>>  SOURCE - Portal + Google Sheets |
